scripts.dev: npm run force-close && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix name --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow" "node scripts/py.js scripts/tee_log.py latest_logs/backend.log node scripts/venv_py.js -u app.py" "node scripts/py.js scripts/tee_log.py latest_logs/frontend.log npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.check: npm --prefix frontend run type-check && node scripts/venv_py.js -m pytest tests/ -q
